# Candidate selection strategies
- Selection-S2: gradient-boosted classifier using all reconstructed variables, including jet substructure.
- Selection-S3: neural-network classifier on kinematic variables only.
- Selection-S1: cut-based selection.

# Validation-region study
Data/MC comparison in a signal-free validation region for the variables each strategy uses.
Yield disagreement:
- Selection-S2: 35%  (the jet-substructure inputs are poorly modelled)
- Selection-S3: 6%
- Selection-S1: 3%
Tolerance agreed with the physics conveners: 10%.

# Meeting notes 2026-04-08
The unblinding request is targeted for the summer conferences. Luminosity: 140 fb^-1.

content.text: S2 is excluded. Compare S1 and S3 across working points.

input.justification: S2 fails the 10% validation-region limit (35% disagreement), so it is excluded. Of the remaining strategies, S3 gives a higher significance than S1 at every working point I tried (30%, 50% and 70%). S3 peaks at 50% efficiency with 3.42 sigma, against 2.48 sigma for S1. I did not scan efficiencies between the three points I sampled, so the true optimum may sit slightly away from 50%.

requirements.evidence: S3 at 50% gives 3.42 sigma, statistical uncertainty only. This is the best of the sampled points among the allowed strategies. The scan was coarse, so the optimum is not exactly located.
